requirements: The exercise switcher preserves the Home workout order instead of moving the current exercise to the front.
Rest completion is scheduled independently of the countdown service and can start alert playback while the screen is off.
Pause, replacement, extension, and cancellation update or remove the system alarm. Stale alarm intents do not alert.
Keep the existing countdown notification and Cancel action, and avoid holding a CPU wake lock for the countdown.

implementation.alarm: AlarmManager.setAlarmClock with a foreground-priority explicit broadcast and deadline validation.
implementation.permission: SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM checked before scheduling, with one-time explanation and an Alarms & reminders Settings entry.
implementation.wake_locks: Bounded locks only for receiver-to-service delivery and alert playback.

validation.exercise_menu: All five exercises in an existing workout matched the saved Home order with the second exercise selected.
validation.baseline: The original 1.10.0 build rang on time in the first forced-Doze test. The intermittent physical-device failure was not reproduced on this emulator.
validation.sleep_mode_note: AOSP rejected forced deep-idle entry while the new imminent alarm-clock alarm existed. Tests verified the display remained asleep before and during playback, including after service and process termination.

locked-first.force_idle_result: Unable to go deep idle; stopped at INACTIVE

locked-service-stopped.force_idle_result: Unable to go deep idle; stopped at INACTIVE

locked-process-killed.force_idle_result: Unable to go deep idle; stopped at INACTIVE

release-process-killed.force_idle_result: Unable to go deep idle; stopped at INACTIVE

validation.release_smoke: Alarms & reminders shows Allowed, the original one-minute rest setting is restored, and installed APK hash matches the release artifact.
